correctness.rationale: Normalized axial beta density (d+1)(1-u)^d gives E[T²]=2/((d+2)(d+3)), and transverse ball sections give E[X_i²]=(d+1)/((d+2)(d+3)); orthogonal basis yields row kernel 1+a_d x·X+c_d tT. Convexity and rotational symmetry reduce global maximum to axial tips vs equatorial sphere. Symmetric-Z moment comparison gives equator B_d<=sqrt(a_d); the axial A_d>(d+3)/2 dominates for d>=3 since d²>=5, while d=2 follows from exact A_2=10561/4000>sqrt(20/3); d=1 coordinate-exchange symmetry. Integrating beta axial marginal exactly gives the formula. Kernel sign attains norm; indicator of negative kernel gives exact positive-input undershoot. Independent exact rational inequalities passed for d=1..150, and strict d=2 fraction was verified. No finite experiment is used to prove all dimensions. The asymptotic expansion is consistent with logarithmic expansion of exact norm.

final_claim: For all integers d>=1, the L2(normalized full Lebesgue volume) projection P onto all affine real functions on D_d={|t|+||x||_2<=1} has norm 1+(d+3)/2*(1-2/((d+2)(d+3)))^(d+2); for d>=2 its only kernel-row maximizing points are axial tips, while d=1 has four coordinate tips. Max negative excursion on input [0,1] is (norm-1)/2.
